input.note:
Cause: data-ledger-db-0 is stuck in Terminating because it is still in active use. Pod ledger-db-0 is Running/Ready on ip-10-0-71-12.ec2.internal and mounts volume "data" -> PVC data-ledger-db-0. The kubernetes.io/pvc-protection finalizer deliberately blocks removal of a PVC while a Pod still references it, so deletion is postponed until no Pod uses it [cite: concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#storage-object-in-use-protection-0]. The Terminating status + pvc-protection finalizer you are seeing is exactly that mechanism, not a stuck controller [cite: concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#storage-object-in-use-protection-1].

Do NOT force-remove the finalizer. The PVC backs the live ledger-db Postgres volume (gp3, 200Gi, reclaimPolicy=Delete). Stripping kubernetes.io/pvc-protection while the pod is still mounted would let the PV be deleted by the provisioner and destroy the ledger DB data.

Fix the owner can apply: the cleanup script targeted a PVC that is still in use. Either (a) exclude data-ledger-db-0 from the quarterly cleanup (it belongs to the live StatefulSet ledger-db and should not be deleted), or (b) if the intent really is to retire this volume, first scale the ledger-db StatefulSet to 0 (or delete the ledger-db-0 pod and prevent it from being recreated). Once no Pod references the PVC, the pvc-protection finalizer will be removed automatically and the delete will complete, unblocking the cleanup Job [cite: concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#storage-object-in-use-protection-0]. Given reclaimPolicy=Delete, option (b) will also delete the underlying EBS volume, so take a verified backup first. Node patching tonight is unaffected either way.
